sonnet.problem: The joke about heat showing which cookies hold their shape is the same idea as the answer to the next choice card (the differences show who is approved). The setup hands the baker the answer ahead of card 6.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card says Paul takes them 'back to the source' and ties it to 'the Lord Jesus Himself.' That points to the Lord as the source and rules out Peter, the wrong answer on the true/false card 14.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
